title: Dashboard loads and shows primary overview content
description: Verifies the dashboard renders summary metrics, charts, and recent activity preview.

steps.description: Scroll to the dashboard charts section
Verify overview summary metrics are displayed
Verify a recent transactions preview is displayed

title: Dashboard spending donut chart shows tooltip on slice hover
description: Verifies hovering a donut slice reveals contextual tooltip details.

steps.description: Scroll to the spending breakdown donut chart
Hover over a spending donut chart slice to reveal details
Verify a chart tooltip with slice details is visible

title: Dashboard balance trend chart renders historical trend visualization
description: Verifies the balance trend chart is present to show historical balance movement.

steps.description: Scroll to the balance trend chart
Verify a balance trend chart is displayed
Verify charted balance history is visible

title: Dashboard handles empty or low-data state with guidance
description: Verifies the dashboard shows an empty/low-data state and guidance when data is insufficient.

steps.description: Scroll through the dashboard overview and charts area
Verify an empty or low-data state is shown for charts or recent activity
Verify a guidance prompt to add transactions is visible

title: Transactions page allows creating a new transaction end-to-end
description: Verifies a user can add a transaction and see it appear in the list.

steps.description: Fill "Groceries E2E" into the description field
Fill a valid date into the date field
Verify the transactions list contains "Groceries E2E"

title: Transactions create flow shows validation then allows correction and save
description: Verifies required/invalid fields block saving and can be corrected to save successfully.

steps.description: Fill "Invalid Amount Test" into the description field
Fill an invalid amount into the amount field
Verify a form validation error is visible
Fill a valid date into the date field
Verify the transactions list contains "Invalid Amount Test"

title: Edit an existing transaction and see updated values in the list
description: Verifies a transaction can be edited and the updated description is shown in the table.

steps.description: Fill "Edit Me" into the description field
Fill a valid date into the date field
Locate the transaction with description "Edit Me" in the list
Fill "Edited Name" into the description field
Verify the transactions list contains "Edited Name"

title: Edit flow blocks invalid data and cancel leaves original unchanged
description: Verifies validation appears during edit and cancel preserves the last saved values.

steps.description: Fill "Cancel Edit Original" into the description field
Fill a valid date into the date field
Locate the transaction with description "Cancel Edit Original" in the list
Fill an invalid amount into the amount field
Verify a form validation error is visible
Verify the transactions list contains "Cancel Edit Original"

title: Delete a transaction after confirming removal
description: Verifies confirming deletion removes the transaction from the list.

steps.description: Fill "Delete Me" into the description field
Fill a valid date into the date field
Locate the transaction with description "Delete Me" in the list
Verify the transactions list does not contain "Delete Me"

title: Delete confirmation cancel keeps the transaction in the list
description: Verifies canceling deletion leaves the transaction unchanged.

steps.description: Fill "Do Not Delete" into the description field
Fill a valid date into the date field
Locate the transaction with description "Do Not Delete" in the list
Verify the transactions list contains "Do Not Delete"

title: Filter transactions by search and filters, then clear to restore full list
description: Verifies search/filter controls narrow results and clearing restores the full table.

steps.description: Fill "Filter Alpha" into the description field
Fill a valid date into the date field
Fill "Filter Beta" into the description field
Fill a valid date into the date field
Use search to filter transactions by text "Filter Alpha"
Verify the transactions list results match the applied filters and search
Click the control to clear all filters
Verify the transactions list contains both "Filter Alpha" and "Filter Beta"

title: No-results state appears for restrictive filters and recovers when cleared
description: Verifies the table shows a no-results state and returns after adjusting filters.

steps.description: Use search to filter transactions by text that matches no items
Apply filters that yield no results
Verify a no transactions found state is displayed
Click the control to clear all filters
Verify the transactions list is restored to showing available transactions

title: Insights page loads and shows comparisons, rankings, and anomalies content
description: Verifies the insights page renders core analytical sections and anomaly/tips area.

steps.description: Scroll to the month-over-month comparison section
Scroll to the top spending categories section
Verify month-over-month income vs expense numbers are displayed
Verify top spending category rankings or progress bars are displayed

title: Acknowledge or dismiss an anomaly alert in insights
description: Verifies an anomaly alert can be dismissed/acknowledged from the UI.

steps.description: Scroll to the anomaly alerts section
Acknowledge or dismiss an anomaly alert
Verify the acknowledged or dismissed anomaly alert is no longer shown

title: Insights shows insufficient-data notice when history is too short
description: Verifies the insights page can present an insufficient-data notice and guidance.

steps.description: Scroll through the insights content area
Verify an insufficient-data notice is displayed
Verify guidance to add more transactions or expand the date range is visible

title: Persist Dark theme across reload
description: Verifies switching to Dark theme applies app-wide and persists after a page reload.

steps.description: Verify the app is displayed in dark theme

title: Switch back to Light theme
description: Verifies switching the theme back to Light applies across the app.

steps.description: Verify the app is displayed in light theme

title: Viewer role hides or disables editing and destructive actions across the app
description: Verifies switching to Viewer reduces UI affordances for editing/deleting in transaction management areas.

steps.description: Click the navigation link to view transactions
Verify transaction editing and destructive actions are hidden or disabled

title: Viewer role cannot initiate editing on a transaction
description: Verifies a Viewer cannot access transaction editing from the transactions list.

steps.description: Click the navigation link to view transactions
Attempt to initiate editing on a transaction
Verify the transaction editing option is not available or is disabled

title: Admin role re-enables editing and destructive actions
description: Verifies switching to Admin restores edit/delete affordances in transaction management areas.

steps.description: Click the navigation link to view transactions
Verify transaction editing and destructive actions are available

title: Theme setting remains consistent when navigating between pages
description: Verifies the chosen theme remains applied when moving across dashboard, transactions, and insights pages.

steps.description: Click the navigation link to view transactions
Click the navigation link to view insights
Verify the app is displayed in dark theme

title: Role setting remains consistent when navigating between pages
description: Verifies the selected role persists across page navigation within the app session.

steps.description: Click the navigation link to view transactions
Click the navigation link to view insights
Click the navigation link to view transactions
Verify transaction editing and destructive actions are hidden or disabled

title: Reload retains Viewer role restrictions
description: Verifies that after switching to Viewer, reloading keeps editing/destructive actions restricted.

steps.description: Click the navigation link to view transactions
Verify transaction editing and destructive actions are hidden or disabled
